name: Roselica
source:
An arrogant and uppity sadist, she has absolute confidence in her attractiveness and talent and disdains all others (Fellow Queen members are an exception). Males under her are treated no better than slaves. She wields psychokinetic powers when the power of her Mantle Armament is initiated.

She has extensive knowledge of abusing males, but her knowledge of sex is shallow as she sees males as no different from toys. A virgin.
